compile.command: uv run nl2repo harbor compile catalog/sources/tinydb --output .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/compiled --toolchain toolchain.lock.toml --artifact-root .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/artifacts --allow-private

empty.command: uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/compiled/tinydb -a nop --jobs-dir .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/runs/empty --n-attempts 1 --n-concurrent 1 --yes

forgery.command: uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/controls-forgery/tinydb-forgery -a oracle --jobs-dir .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/runs/forgery --n-attempts 1 --n-concurrent 1 --yes

offline.command: Verifier-integrated no-network probes in the Oracle, empty, stub, and forgery runs

stub.command: uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/controls-stub/tinydb-stub -a oracle --jobs-dir .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/runs/stub --n-attempts 1 --n-concurrent 1 --yes

oracle.command: uv run --frozen --project harbor-runner harbor run -p .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/compiled/tinydb -a oracle --jobs-dir .nl2repo/task-artifacts/tinydb-production/runs/oracle --n-attempts 1 --n-concurrent 1 --yes
